commands.title: New terminal
commands.description: Open a new login-shell terminal in the workspace and focus it. With command, the terminal runs that command instead of a shell; the tab stays open after it exits. command is user-only: an agent call with it is refused. Returns {session}.

cwd.description: Working directory; the first workspace folder (or home) when absent.

command.description: Argument list to run instead of the login shell. User only; refused from an agent.

commands.title: Close terminal
commands.description: Close a terminal session, killing whatever runs in it; a no-op when the session is absent or unknown.

commands.title: Terminal busy
commands.description: Report whether a terminal session is running a process besides its shell: {busy, process}, process the name of its newest one, empty when not busy.

sessionId.description: Session to check; an unknown or exited one is not busy.

busy.description: Whether a descendant of the shell is alive.

process.description: Name of the newest such process; empty when not busy.
